parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: when I do well in my exams.
has little industry. The soldiers carried the sticks
into the field in order to make a fire.

parts.text: People drive dangerously after drinking alcohol. I feel proud when I do well in my exams. We throw useless things away. We can avoid becoming ill by living a healthy life. Most people are very busy on Mondays. Blind people read with special books made for them. An under developed country has little industry. The soldiers carried the sticks into the field in order to make a fire.
